anya (partnerships): flagging: CloudReach SI asked to co-host a listing announcement on their partner portal. PO attached claims 10 racks reserved for the joint pilot, but vendor manifest just shows 5 assigned. we need to decide fast because CloudReach PR has a fixed publish window. :grimacing:
mike (procurement): our contract ties Q3 committed racks = 10. vendor reps acknowledged a partial allocation error earlier this week.
rachel (logistics): update from yard: two containers cleared, one still in QA inspection. manifest excerpt: ```PO: CR-1100
allocated_racks: 5
containers: CT-1201, CT-1202, CT-1207(held)
eta: 2026-04-03 (held)```
cory (eng-ops): runtime note: we can create a temporary demo cluster using 5 assigned racks + 3 hosted warm nodes. will need a routing rule and a cost center tag. performance will be degraded for the live demo but acceptable for feature showcase.
pipeline-bot: [inventory-check] dedicated-committed: 10 ; manifest-assigned: 5 ; hosted-warm: 8 ; eu-spare: 1
hannah (sales): CloudReach insists on calling it a "live demo of Dedicated SKU" in marketing. we must be careful.
david (legal): advise: avoid SKU guarantee language. propose "live demo on limited dedicated capacity" and add a line "full capacity subject to shipping manifests."
mike (procurement): mitigation options: 1) request vendor expedite the held container (cost +$35k) 2) borrow 2 racks from EU spare + 1 hosted warm 3) adjust announcement copy to reflect limited capacity and staggered availability.
rachel (logistics): expediting has no customs guarantee. held container may be cleared in 24-72h.
cory (eng-ops): requesting infra approval for routing rule: ```routing_policy: allow-hosted-warm-fallback=true
note: attach latency, p95 +12%```. engineering can enable within 1h with infra sign-off.
anya (partnerships): CloudReach wants a commitment in 2 hours. what's safe and fastest?
mike (procurement): safest is option 3 with conservative copy. but if marketing insists on demo, option 2 is fastest compromise.
hannah (sales): i'll negotiate marketing language: "Live demo on limited dedicated capacity; full Dedicated SKU availability will follow final provisioning."
david (legal): approved wording. also require vendor to confirm expected manifest update before final PR.
anya (partnerships): action items: Mike -> vendor confirmation, Cory -> infra routing request, Rachel -> customs chase, Hannah -> vendor/NPI comms. I'll send CloudReach the provisional language and ETA. :rocket:
